Bid Information:

Bids will be received until 2:00 p.m. Central Standard Time on Thursday, December 3, 2026., at the offices of the Memphis Housing Authority, 700 Adams Avenue, Memphis, Tennessee or Online at www.mhaplanroom.com under the submit bid tab, at which time and place all bids will be publicly opened and read aloud.

One Pre-Bid Conference will be held Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. CST at the Memphis Housing Authority, 700 Adams Avenue, Boardroom, Capital Improvements Office. Site visits can be scheduled Mon-Fri 8 to 3:30 PM Monday, November 9, 2026 through Tuesday, November 17, 2026. To schedule a site visit, please contact Kim Sample, Capital Improvements Director at kim.sample@example.org. Although neither the Pre-Bid Conference nor the site visit is a bidding requirement, all offerors are strongly encouraged to attend.

Bid documents can also to purchased and viewed at www.mhaplanroom.com. Please reference the project name and solicitation number when requesting documents. Please contact Kim Sample, Director of Capital Improvements at 901-555-0102 or via email at kim.sample@example.org with questions.
